offices.source: Wikipedia, "Shannon Taylor (attorney)": its summary box gives the term from January 1, 2012 (that date has no footnote; her November 2011 election is cited to NBC12); her campaign site also says she was elected Henrico County Commonwealth's Attorney in 2011 and has been the county's top prosecutor for 14 years
